faqs.question: What is Chessmasters?
faqs.answer: Chessmasters is an AI chess game analyzer for Chess.com and Lichess. You paste a finished game and receive a plain-English coaching report with five sections: Strength, Weakness, Game Overview, Focus Areas, and Resources.

faqs.question: Is Chessmasters free?
faqs.answer: The first analysis is free and does not require an account. Signing in unlocks four more free analyses, five in total. After that, the Pro plan is INR 399 per month and includes 100 analyses per billing period.

faqs.question: Does it work with both Chess.com and Lichess?
faqs.answer: Yes. For Lichess, paste the game URL and Chessmasters fetches it directly. For Chess.com, enter your username and the game URL and it finds the game in the public archive of the last three months.

faqs.question: How is this different from Chess.com Game Review or raw engine analysis?
faqs.answer: Engine tools tell you which move lost centipawns. Chessmasters runs Stockfish first, then explains what happened as a lesson: the named tactical motif you missed, why the position changed, and exactly what to train next, with drills linked to Lichess training material.

faqs.question: What is included in each report?
faqs.answer: Every report covers Strength, Weakness, Game Overview, Focus Areas, and Resources. Key moments are shown on interactive boards, and evaluation and accuracy charts visualize how the game turned. Pro users can also ask follow-up questions about their game.

faqs.question: How long does an analysis take?
faqs.answer: The report streams in real time and typically finishes in about 10 to 15 seconds for a single game.

faqs.question: Do I need to install anything or connect my account?
faqs.answer: No. Chessmasters analyzes public games from Chess.com and Lichess. You never share a password — a game URL is enough, plus your username for Chess.com games.

faqs.question: What is the AI Psychological Profile?
faqs.answer: After three analyzed games, Chessmasters builds a profile of how you play under pressure, including Tilt Resistance, Composure, and your Playing Style, based on the blunders in your own games.

faqs.question: Who designs the coaching in the reports?
faqs.answer: The coaching logic is designed with FIDE Arena International Master (AIM) Parth Kaushik, a competitive instructor with a 2300+ peak Chess.com rating.

faqs.question: Is Chessmasters affiliated with Chess.com or Lichess?
faqs.answer: No. Chessmasters is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Chess.com, Lichess.org, or the Stockfish project.
